content: (The location is now Snow Veil Sanctum.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Mercer Frey, Katie, Serana, Restless Draugr, Hulking Draugr)

Lydia: Another draugr crypt. At least these bones are Nords, not some foreign filth defiling our lands. Mornhilde Raven-Hair: Aye, but even Nord dead can rise to haunt the living. I wonder what Mercer hopes to find in this place. Lydia: Treasure, no doubt. The Guild always chases coin like milk-drinkers chase skirts. But as long as it helps MJR, I'll swing my blade.
